subject: Thomas Brooks Park Master Plan
overview: The Medford Historical Commission reviewed updated design concepts for Thomas Brooks Park, accepted a demolition review application for 27 Almont Street, and approved funding requests for cemetery fieldwork and a Form B inventory.

items.title: Thomas Brooks Park Master Plan Concepts
items.summary: Peter Hedlund presented design concepts for Thomas Brooks Park, including an accessible history walk, interpretive signage, plantings, and subtle surface marking of the historic house site.

items.title: 27 Almont Street Demolition Review Application
items.summary: The commission voted 6-0 to accept the demolition application as to form, deferring the significance determination to the next meeting.

items.title: Cross Street Cemetery Funding
items.summary: The commission approved a $1,100 appropriation for preliminary fieldwork on headstone foundations ahead of a comprehensive cemetery assessment.

items.title: 82 Greenleaf Form B Appropriation
items.summary: Approved a $500 expenditure for an MHC Form B inventory for fire-damaged 82 Greenleaf.

items.title: General Updates and Project Reports
items.summary: Members discussed pending survey projects, CPA application status, local historic district proposals, and recent regional development matters.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the meeting minutes from February 2024.
